reason: The patch removes the only rule that set `padding-top: 4px` on `.small-action-desc > p` (common/base/topic-post.scss, around line 300). No other stylesheet adds top padding to these `p` elements, and browsers give `p` no padding by default, so `.small-action .small-action-desc p { padding-top: 0 }` in mobile/topic-post.scss:516-519 no longer does anything.
